import {spawn} from 'node:child_process'
import {cpSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'
import {join} from 'node:path'
import {tempDir} from '@conciv/vitest-config/temp-dir'

declare function bootKit(options: {cwd: string}): void

export function readPaths(root: string): string {
  bootKit({cwd: tmpdir()})
  spawn('ls', [], {cwd: tmpdir()})
  const folder = tempDir('x')
  mkdirSync(join(root, 'a'))
  writeFileSync(join(folder, 'f'), tmpdir())
  cpSync(join(tmpdir(), 'source'), join(root, 'copy'))
  rmSync(join(tmpdir(), 'gone'), {recursive: true, force: true})
  return readFileSync(join(tmpdir(), 'f'), 'utf8')
}
